skill.displayName: 大藏经学术引用生成器

version.changelog: 初始发布：CBETA 学术脚注生成，支持按编号或经文反查，输出附路径式行级深链（精确到页栏行）。

llm.summary: The citation skill is mostly purpose-aligned, but it includes an optional authenticated lookup script that asks users to provide a browser login cookie despite documentation also claiming the scripts do not read credentials.

dimensions.detail: Network access to CBETA is proportionate for lookup, but the optional third-party authenticated lookup requires copying a whole browser Cookie into an environment variable or local file and sends it as a Cookie header; the curl fallback can also place that Cookie in process arguments.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Python scripts and a bundled JSON data table, with no separate installer or background setup. One script can regenerate the local publisher data table from CBETA when the JSON file is missing or when the refresh script is run.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most instructions are scoped to citation generation, but SKILL.md simultaneously says the scripts do not read personal credentials and that an optional script reads a login Cookie from FO_COOKIE or fo_cookie.txt; that contradiction creates under-disclosure around credential handling.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, privilege escalation, deletion, or broad local indexing was found. The skill writes only 藏经出版社.json during data refresh and may read a local fo_cookie.txt if the optional authenticated locator is used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main CBETA citation and lookup behavior fits the stated academic-reference purpose, but the optional 中华大藏经定位.py uses a third-party fo.ancientbooks.cn search endpoint with a user-provided login Cookie, which is more sensitive than the high-level citation-generator description suggests.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a citation helper that runs local Python scripts and makes network requests. Avoid using the optional 中华大藏经定位.py unless you understand the risk of placing a full website login Cookie in FO_COOKIE or fo_cookie.txt; prefer using the CBETA-only workflows when possible.
llm.findings:
[AST4] expected: Confirmed subprocess execution of the packaged 更新藏经数据.py helper only when the bundled publisher JSON is missing. This is local helper execution and should be disclosed, but it is purpose-aligned and not shell-interpolated.
[LP3] unexpected: Partly supported: ordinary file, network, and command use are expected for these scripts, but the skill does not clearly separate the optional credential-backed third-party lookup from the lower-risk CBETA citation workflow.
[TP4] unexpected: The artifact does not show tool poisoning or hidden unrelated behavior, but it does materially broaden the trust boundary through optional fo.ancientbooks.cn authenticated lookup that is not reflected in the top-level metadata description.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported: SKILL.md claims all scripts rely on official CBETA APIs and local data while also documenting an optional script that depends on fo.ancientbooks.cn login state.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported: SKILL.md says the scripts do not read or write personal credentials, yet 中华大藏经定位.py reads FO_COOKIE or fo_cookie.txt and uses it as an HTTP Cookie.
[SDI-2] expected: Confirmed, but downgraded: the auto-generation helper is a packaged maintenance script for a missing local data file, not an obfuscated or unrelated execution path.
